ig_caption:
Two lines decide whether your skill ever runs ⚠️

The front matter at the top of SKILL.md:
🏷 name: a short id
🎯 description: what it does AND when to use it

At the start, the agent reads only these lines for every skill, not the instructions. So the description is the trigger.
❌ "Helps with docs." tells it nothing
✅ "Writes release notes from merged pull requests. Use when asked for a changelog." tells it exactly when

Part 2/5 of AI Skills Explained. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
